office.name: VibeX Office
office.summary: Create, edit, analyze, and preview DOCX, XLSX, and PPTX files in VibeX.
office.readme:
# VibeX Office

Keep Word, Excel, and PowerPoint work inside the VibeX workspace.

After you enable it:

- Open `.docx`, `.xlsx`, and `.pptx` files for a read-only preview.
- Agents get three Skills for documents, spreadsheets, and slides.
- Composer shows six Workflows for create, modify, analyze, and generate.

## Enable

This plugin ships with the Host, starts off, and cannot be uninstalled. Turn it on in Plugins. The first enable binds Skills and Workflows to compatible installed Agents.

Preview uses the Host-locked `officecli` Runtime. Do not replace it with another copy from your PATH.

## Preview

Opening a supported file starts a read-only preview. It is not an in-window editor. After the idle timeout the preview process stops; opening the file again starts a new one.

Supported files: `.docx`, `.xlsx`, `.pptx`. Legacy `.doc` / `.xls` / `.ppt` are out of scope.

## Agent work

Describe the result. The Agent should use this plugin's Skills and the locked `officecli`, then return a workspace-relative path. Leave unnamed structure, styles, sheets, and slides alone. Validate before calling the work done.

## Configuration

The only setting is preview idle timeout (1–60 minutes, default 10). Saving writes this plugin's `config.json`. Open previews are unchanged.

## Troubleshooting

If a file will not open, check the extension and that the plugin is enabled. If preview exits immediately, re-enable the plugin so Host can probe `officecli` again.

workflowCreator.name: Workflow Creator
workflowCreator.summary: Create, inspect, debug, and safely revise VibeX DAG workflows from conversations and editable file tabs.
workflowCreator.readme:
# Workflow Creator

Author VibeX DAG workflows as real files, then validate, debug, and publish them.

Once enabled, the Skill, the workflow MCP, and Workflow Studio work together. The source file is the authoring fact. Saving uses an artifact revision and refuses a stale overwrite. Publishing creates an immutable version. Automations stay on the version they already reference.

## Enable

This plugin ships with the Host, starts off, and cannot be uninstalled. VibeX Desktop must be running so Host can start the loopback gateway and inject a short-lived token. That token is never stored in this package.

## Edit, debug, publish

Open a `*.vibex-workflow.json` file to use Workflow Studio. Save and validate before any test. `workflow_debug_source` tests unpublished source without creating a catalog version. Publish only when you want a release.

## Configuration

Default Agent Step completion is the authoring default for new steps that do not declare a policy. It does not rewrite existing steps or running workflows.

## Troubleshooting

If MCP says VibeX is unavailable, keep Desktop open and re-enable the plugin. A save conflict means the source changed outside the tab — reload, then save. An Automation that ignores edits is pinned to an older published version.

sessionEnhance.name: Session Enhance
sessionEnhance.summary: Let the agent ask questions, read mid-turn notes, query a mentioned session, and control this session or its children.
sessionEnhance.readme:
# Session Enhance

These tools come from the VibeX Host, not from a particular Agent. After you enable the plugin, Host injects them only into sessions opened or rebound later.

## Capabilities

- Live feedback: the agent should call `check_user_feedback` before work and after each stage.
- Ask the user: `ask_user_question` blocks until you answer a real decision.
- Session info: read-only lookup of a session you linked.
- Session control: send input, cancel a turn, or wait, only on this session or its descendants.

## Configuration

Each capability has its own switch, on by default. Saving writes this plugin's `config.json` and affects later new or rebound sessions only.

## Troubleshooting

If the agent has no these tools, enable the matching switch and open or rebind a session. An already injected session keeps its tool list until it ends.

multiAgent.name: Multi-agent
multiAgent.summary: Let a parent agent hand a subtask to another agent.
multiAgent.readme:
# Multi-agent

The parent agent hands a bounded subtask to another agent. `&` in the composer names a target; `delegate_to_agent` is what actually starts the work.

Turning this plugin on or off is the delegation switch. Depth, result cache, and child-agent defaults live only on this page, and they apply only to new child sessions started by delegation.

## Enable

The plugin ships with the Host, starts off, and cannot be uninstalled. After you turn it on, Host injects `vibex-delegation-mcp` into later new or rebound sessions, and `&` appears in the composer.

## Configuration

Maximum depth limits root → child → grandchild recursion (1–8, default 1). Completed-result cache is in-memory for the running delegation session (MB, default 512, 0 means no cap). Child-agent defaults override only delegated child sessions, not global new-session defaults.

## Troubleshooting

If `&` is missing, the plugin is off or the session was opened before it was enabled. A mention is not a started task — the parent must call `delegate_to_agent`.

depthLimit.description: How deep a root → child → grandchild chain may go.

completedCacheMaxMb.title: Completed result cache (MB)
completedCacheMaxMb.description: In-memory cache for finished child results in a running delegation session. 0 means no cap; the cache still clears when the session ends.

agentDefaults.title: Child agent defaults

pluginDevelopment.name: Plugin Development
pluginDevelopment.summary: Let an agent develop, validate, and link plugins with this Host's SDK and CLI.
pluginDevelopment.readme:
# Plugin Development

Gives plugin authors the toolchain that matches the running Host: Skill, SDK, CLI, and an optional development MCP. Do not download a random template, and do not assume a VibeX source tree is on disk.

Enabling the plugin delivers the Skill. Development MCP stays off until you turn it on, so ordinary sessions do not get tools that link a local directory.

## Toolchain

Ask the running Host for the toolchain with `vibex plugin toolchain`, or use the `vibex-plugin` next to the Host binary. Then validate, test, build, and pack against those local contracts.

## Link a local directory

Turn on Development MCP, open or rebind a session, and let the agent call `plugin_dev_link_request`. Confirm Full Trust in VibeX. Do not paste a loopback token into the chat.

## Troubleshooting

If link tools are missing, Development MCP is off — enable it and start a new session. If a link stays pending, confirm Full Trust in VibeX.
